items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: The second Marshall at that time was old man Alexander. He's dead too now. He's dead too now. He said that was the next Marshall after he died.

ctx.x: Ace Watson. The next one behind him was Johnny Salisbury. He was a good Marshall. He was a good Marshall. And up until late now Alexander he was the next good one. We had another Marshall who died. I can't even think of his name. But he was a pretty good Marshall too.
But what makes a Marshall a good Marshall?
